name: NMN (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide)
timing_instruction: Fasted upon waking (07:00 - 08:30) for SIRT1 and NAMPT circadian peak
target_pathway: Cellular NAD+ biosynthesis, PARP1 DNA repair
key_warning: Take with TMG (Trimethylglycine) to prevent methyl pool depletion

name: Magnesium Glycinate
timing_instruction: 30-45 minutes before sleep (21:30 - 22:30)
target_pathway: GABA-A receptor agonism, NMDA receptor blockade
key_warning: Never co-administer with Calcium or high-dose Zinc

name: Magnesium L-Threonate (Magtein)
timing_instruction: 1 hour before sleep (crosses blood-brain barrier)
target_pathway: Synaptic plasticity, hippocampal density, deep slow-wave sleep
key_warning: Does not replace systemic magnesium needs for muscle cramps

name: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)
timing_instruction: Consume with the highest-fat meal of the day (12:30 - 13:30)
target_pathway: Nuclear VDR transcription, immune cell gene regulation
key_warning: Mandatory co-administration with Vitamin K2 (MK-7) to prevent vascular calcification

name: Vitamin K2 (Menaquinone-7 / MK-7)
timing_instruction: With midday meal alongside Vitamin D3 and dietary fats
target_pathway: Carboxylation of Osteocalcin and Matrix Gla Protein (MGP)
key_warning: Strictly contraindicated with Warfarin / Coumadin

name: Omega-3 (EPA / DHA)
timing_instruction: With meals to prevent lipid oxidation and reflux
target_pathway: Cell membrane fluidity, resolvins/protectins anti-inflammatory cascade
key_warning: High doses (>3g) exert additive anti-platelet blood thinning effects

name: Ashwagandha (KSM-66 / Sensoril)
timing_instruction: Early evening (18:00 - 19:30). Cycle 6 weeks on, 2 weeks off
target_pathway: HPA-axis modulation, serum cortisol suppression
key_warning: Risk of thyroid stimulation (TSH drop), liver enzyme elevation, and emotional anhedonia if uncycled

name: L-Theanine
timing_instruction: Morning with espresso (1:2 ratio) or bedtime for slow-wave sleep
target_pathway: Glutamate receptor antagonism, cortical alpha-wave generation
key_warning: Extremely safe with high therapeutic index

name: Berberine HCl
timing_instruction: 15-20 minutes before high-carbohydrate meals (500mg)
target_pathway: Mitochondrial Complex I mild inhibition, AMPK phosphorylation
key_warning: Do not combine with Metformin; inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6

name: Creatine Monohydrate
timing_instruction: Daily 5g with carbohydrate/protein for insulin-mediated muscle/brain uptake
target_pathway: Phosphocreatine shuttle, rapid cellular ATP resynthesis
key_warning: Raises serum creatinine harmlessly (does not reflect true kidney injury; verify via Cystatin-C)

name: BPC-157 (Body Protection Compound)
timing_instruction: Fasted 250mcg - 500mcg (Oral arginate for gut lining; SubQ for systemic tendon repair)
target_pathway: VEGF upregulation, FAK-paxillin angiogenesis, eNOS stimulation
key_warning: High theoretical angiogenesis rate; avoid in active malignancy

name: CoQ10 (Ubiquinol)
timing_instruction: 100-200mg with midday meal containing dietary lipids
target_pathway: Mitochondrial electron transport chain (Complex I/II to III), lipid antioxidant
key_warning: Essential if taking Statins (statins block the mevalonate pathway synthesizing natural CoQ10)

name: NAC (N-Acetyl Cysteine)
timing_instruction: Fasted with water (600mg - 1200mg). Do not take within 2 hours of alcohol
target_pathway: Cysteine rate-limiting step in intracellular GSH synthesis
key_warning: Chelates essential zinc and copper; must separate from trace minerals by 2 hours

name: Tongkat Ali (Eurycoma Longifolia)
timing_instruction: Morning with food (200-400mg standardized eurycomanone). Cycle 5 days on, 2 days off
target_pathway: Displaces bound testosterone from SHBG, stimulates luteinizing hormone (LH)
key_warning: Can cause insomnia if taken late in day; check liver enzymes quarterly

name: Alpha-GPC (L-Alpha glycerylphosphorylcholine)
timing_instruction: 300-600mg before cognitive work
target_pathway: Crosses BBB, synthesizes Acetylcholine and membrane phosphatidylcholine
key_warning: Chronic daily high doses convert to TMAO via gut bacteria; pair with garlic extract / allicin

name: Apigenin
timing_instruction: 50mg 1 hour before sleep
target_pathway: Inhibits CD38 enzyme to preserve cellular NAD+; acts as positive allosteric GABA-A modulator
key_warning: Mild estrogen receptor modulator at supra-physiological doses

name: Semaglutide / Tirzepatide (GLP-1 Agonist)
timing_instruction: Subcutaneous injection once weekly on fixed day
target_pathway: GLP-1R / GIPR central appetite suppression, decelerated gastric emptying
key_warning: Delays absorption of all co-administered oral medications by 2-4 hours; hydrate aggressively

name: Levothyroxine (Synthroid / Euthyrox)
timing_instruction: STRICTLY fasted upon waking with water. Zero food, coffee, or pills for 60 minutes
target_pathway: Converts to active T3 via peripheral deiodinase, regulates basal metabolic rate
key_warning: Completely inactivated by co-administered Calcium, Iron, Soy, or espresso

name: Omeprazole / Pantoprazole (PPI)
timing_instruction: 30-60 minutes before the first meal of the day
target_pathway: Irreversible inhibition of H+/K+ ATPase enzyme in gastric parietal cells
key_warning: Chronic use causes severe hypomagnesemia and B12 deficiency due to hypochlorhydria

name: Atorvastatin (Lipitor)
timing_instruction: Nightly before sleep (peak hepatic cholesterol synthesis occurs nocturnally)
target_pathway: HMG-CoA reductase blockade, dramatic LDL receptor upregulation
key_warning: Depletes endogenous CoQ10 (take Ubiquinol); strictly avoid grapefruit furanocoumarins
